do.text: Give the type and size in the detail line, so people know what they are opening.

dont.text: Don't show a bare name: a 40 MB video and a 4 KB note look the same.

title: Offer a way forward when an upload fails

do.text: Mark a failed file and put Retry on it.

dont.text: Don't leave a failed file looking done: people send messages missing it.
